#unzipping the folder presenting raw data and metadata. exdir is the chosen directory to export the unzipped folder. Change file paths as necessary.

```{r}
unzip("C:/Users/Downloads/getdata_projectfiles_UCI HAR Dataset.zip", exdir = "C:/Users/Downloads/projectUCIHAR")
```

#reading .txt file presenting variable names and converting them to chr vector of column names (variable names are present at the #2 column) 
#reading .txt file presenting the full description of levels of activities at the #2 column. We have converted them to a chr vector which will be used as factors in later chunks. 

```{r}
columnnames <- read.table("C:/Users/Downloads/projectUCIHAR/UCI HAR Dataset/features.txt")
listcolumn <- columnnames[,2]
```

```{r}
activitylabels <- read.table("C:/Users/zequi/Downloads/projectUCIHAR/UCI HAR Dataset/activity_labels.txt")
activitylabels2 <- activitylabels[,2]
```

#joining rawdata from training dataset which were splitted in three .txt file (X_train, y_train, and subject_train)
#first list that I created was used to rename columns from the X_train file.
#columns for y_train and subject_train were directly named.
#column binding of the three dataframes.

#do the same process reading the test datasets (X_test, y_test and subject_test .txt files)

#rbinding of training and test datasets and cleaning of duplicated columns. 

```{r}
my_data_trainX <- read.table("C:/Users/zequi/Downloads/projectUCIHAR/UCI HAR Dataset/Train/X_train.txt")
colnames(my_data_trainX) <- unlist(listcolumn)
my_data_trainY <- read.table("C:/Users/zequi/Downloads/projectUCIHAR/UCI HAR Dataset/Train/y_train.txt")
colnames(my_data_trainY) <- "Activity"
my_data_train_subject <- read.table("C:/Users/zequi/Downloads/projectUCIHAR/UCI HAR Dataset/Train/subject_train.txt")
colnames(my_data_train_subject) <- "SubjectID"
```
```{r}
my_data_train <- cbind(my_data_train_subject, my_data_trainY, my_data_trainX)
```
```{r}
my_data_testX <- read.table("C:/Users/zequi/Downloads/projectUCIHAR/UCI HAR Dataset/Test/X_test.txt")
colnames(my_data_testX) <- unlist(listcolumn)
my_data_testY <- read.table("C:/Users/zequi/Downloads/projectUCIHAR/UCI HAR Dataset/Test/y_test.txt")
colnames(my_data_testY) <- "Activity"
my_data_test_subject <- read.table("C:/Users/zequi/Downloads/projectUCIHAR/UCI HAR Dataset/Test/subject_test.txt")
colnames(my_data_test_subject) <- "SubjectID"
```
```{r}
my_data_test <- cbind(my_data_test_subject, my_data_testY, my_data_testX)
```
```{r}
mergeddata <- rbind(my_data_train, my_data_test)
merged_clean <- mergeddata[, !duplicated(colnames(mergeddata))]
```


#arranging/ordering merged data based on subject IDs and converting data from all variables to numeric class.

```{r}
library(dplyr)
merged_clean$SubjectID <- as.numeric(merged_clean$SubjectID)
merged_ordered <- arrange(merged_clean, SubjectID)
merged_ordered1 <- merged_ordered %>%
  mutate(across(everything(), ~ as.numeric(as.character(.x))))
```

#converting Activity column data to factors and then transforming these numeric factors in the strings present in the .txt file/second chr vector created in this script.

```{r}
merged_ordered1$Activity <- as.factor(merged_ordered1$Activity)
class(merged_ordered1$Activity)
```
```{r}
levels(merged_ordered1$Activity)
```
```{r}
levels(merged_ordered1$Activity) <- activitylabels2
```

#creating a dataframe extracting the means and SDs for each variable (except ID and activity) as individual columns. Grep function was used to search for "mean" and "std" in column names. Then, a dataframe is created extracting column 1 and 2 (Subject ID and Activity) and the means and SDs columns starting at column 3.

```{r}
subset <- merged_ordered1[, grep("-(mean|std)\\(\\)", colnames(merged_ordered1))]
subjact <- merged_ordered1[, c(1,2)]
summaryframe <- cbind(subjact, subset)
```

#creating a summary of data grouped by ID and activity (no missing values present in these columns):

```{r}
tidytable <- summaryframe %>%
    group_by(SubjectID, Activity) %>%
        summarise(across(everything(), function(x) mean(x, na.rm=TRUE)))
```

#exporting this table as a .txt file in a specific folder (change file path as necessary):

```{r}
write.table(tidytable, file = "C:/Users/tidytable_persubject_peractivity.txt", row.names = FALSE)
```
